notes.title: Very Late Patches
notes.content:
Fixed Softlock bug, added hints, fixed some lighting issues, removed 32 bit support


A buddy pointed out that this silly little game I made when I was 15 softlocks you out of the final dungeon, so when I had a weekend of free time away from my main rig with only my old laptop, for lack of a better thing to do, I fixed it along with adding tooltip hints to help players along. I also scraped the 32bit version since It's now unnecessary and takes up like 7 gigabytes.

notes.title: Update 1
notes.content:
Amendium has seen a few changes, here are a few;

-Added more clarification in the earlier levels
-Added waypoint arrows in some confusing levels
-Put up signs to make Haven more navigable
-It now shows the requirements to open new portals

The game's flow should benefit from these changes. Have fun!
